description:
Nuestro equipo nace por accidente, así como las cosas que nos gustan hacer, vamos experimentando y siguiendo nuestro instinto. Así mismo fomentamos el compañerismo, la solidaridad, y la competencia.

Naves, ciencia, exploración.
summary: Are you familiar with role-playing games? We envision what kind of scenario might work, and how useful and engaging it would be to develop an application based on it.
details: We speculated about what might be at that base on the moon, and how the tool would function. We took many factors into account, such as temperature, energy production, transport from the pole, rotation, the astronauts' stay and daily routine, and so on.
